notes: Built by clean.py from the pinned Wikisource revisions in metadata.json, which it verifies by checksum; `python3 clean.py --check` reproduces this file byte for byte. Book and chapter headings and numbers dropped, a paragraph per line (verse included), paragraphs separated by a blank line and books by two. No train/test split: consumers split it (indrajala-ml: the first 90% for training, the last 10% held out).
